metadata.description: Community-driven collection of GitHub Copilot plugins, agents, prompts, and skills

plugins.name: accessibility-agents
plugins.description: WCAG 2.2 AA enforcement as Agent Skills: six router skills that dispatch accessibility specialists for web, document, markdown, desktop and GitHub work, hooks that block edits to user-facing files until the accessibility lead has reviewed, and an MCP server with axe, Office, PDF and ePub scanners.

author.name: Community Access (Jeff Bishop and Taylor Arndt)

plugins.name: accessibility-kanban
plugins.description: Kanban board to manage accessibility issues, allow you to plan, track, and complete remediation work.

plugins.name: acreadiness-cockpit
plugins.description: Drive Microsoft AgentRC from Copilot chat: assess AI readiness, generate Copilot instructions (flat or nested with applyTo globs for monorepos), and manage policies. Produces a self-contained static HTML dashboard at reports/index.html.

plugins.name: agent-council
plugins.description: A runtime-portable 5-agent quality gate that adjudicates text artifacts before they ship. Five role-conditioned LLM deliberators run a 2-round async protocol with cross-read rebuttal and return one verdict — SHIP, REVISE, or HOLD — plus a structured revision brief and a full audit transcript.

plugins.name: agent-radar
plugins.description: See a live map of the Copilot agents on your computer, their sub-agents, their commands, and where their data goes.

plugins.name: agentcouncil
plugins.description: Multi-model council for Copilot CLI: three subagents on different model families (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) answer independently, then build on each other or attack the leading answer before an orchestrator writes the final result from anonymized inputs.

plugins.name: ai-credits-breakdown
plugins.description: See exactly where your own GitHub Copilot AI credits go: dollars by day, repository, model, call type and prompt-cache state, built privately on your computer from your Copilot telemetry.

plugins.name: ai-ready
plugins.description: Analyze any repository and generate AI-ready configuration — AGENTS.md, copilot-instructions.md, CI workflows, issue templates, and more. Mines your PR review patterns and creates files customized to your stack.

plugins.name: ai-team-orchestration
plugins.description: Run a lightweight, role-separated AI development team with flexible tools, developer-selected models, proportionate planning, and optional QA.

plugins.name: anarlog
plugins.description: Query Anarlog meetings locally, or connect through OAuth to read opted-in Cloud snapshots.

plugins.name: apify
plugins.description: Helps devs extract data from any website with thousands of trusted scrapers, crawlers, and automations from Apify Store. Integrate ready-made Actors to access all popular social media, video, e-commerce, search engines, maps, and travel sites. Build, debug, publish, and monetize new Actors on Apify.

plugins.name: apng-studio
plugins.description: Interactive GitHub Copilot app canvas extension for building Animated PNG (APNG) files from frames. Draw or upload frames, tune per-frame timing and compositing, preview live, send the result to your phone by QR, and export an animated .png.

plugins.name: arcade-canvas
plugins.description: Play six retro Phaser mini-games in a Copilot canvas while agents work.

plugins.name: arch
plugins.description: Architecture and modernization toolkit: produce a cited architecture document for a locally-cloned repo, and generate a phased modernization plan that auto-runs Documentation mode when needed.

plugins.name: arize-ax
plugins.description: Arize AX platform skills for LLM observability, evaluation, and optimization. Includes trace export, instrumentation, datasets, experiments, evaluators, AI provider integrations, annotations, prompt optimization, and deep linking to the Arize UI.

plugins.name: atlassian-twg-cli
plugins.description: Installs and configures Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI (`twg`) for use with GitHub Copilot. After setup, the CLI provides access to authorized work context across Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and connected tools.

plugins.name: automate-this
plugins.description: Record your screen doing a manual process, drop the video on your Desktop, and let Copilot CLI analyze it frame-by-frame to build working automation scripts. Supports narrated recordings with audio transcription.

plugins.name: awesome-copilot
plugins.description: Meta prompts that help you discover and generate curated GitHub Copilot agents, instructions, prompts, and skills.

plugins.name: aws-cloud-development
plugins.description: Comprehensive AWS cloud development tools including Infrastructure as Code, serverless functions, architecture patterns, and cost optimization for building scalable cloud applications.

plugins.name: aws-core
plugins.description: Build, deploy, and operate applications on AWS. Skills for infrastructure as code (CDK, CloudFormation), core services (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, ECS/Fargate, IAM, Amazon Bedrock), databases, observability, messaging and streaming, AWS SDKs, cost optimization, and Well-Architected reviews.

plugins.name: azure
plugins.description: Microsoft Azure MCP and Skills integration for cloud resource management, deployments, and Azure services. Manage your Azure infrastructure, monitor applications, and deploy resources directly from your development environment.

plugins.name: azure-cloud-development
plugins.description: Comprehensive Azure cloud development tools including Infrastructure as Code, serverless functions, architecture patterns, and cost optimization for building scalable cloud applications.

plugins.name: azure-cost-health-check
plugins.description: Read-only Azure cost, forecasts, budget alerts, Advisor recommendations, and AI billing analysis in a Copilot canvas.

plugins.name: azure-functions
plugins.description: Create, edit, modernize, review, run, deploy, and monitor Azure Function Apps in a Copilot canvas, with optional AI help. Includes official function templates, runtime and configuration checks, and companion skills.

plugins.name: azure-functions-hosted-skills
plugins.description: Build, run, and debug Azure Functions Hosted Skills locally or invoke supported functions in an existing Function App from a Copilot canvas.

plugins.name: azure-resiliency-agent
plugins.description: Validate Azure application architectures and infrastructure-as-code for resiliency gaps, generate new resilient templates, and review existing templates.

plugins.name: azure-resources-query
plugins.description: Browse Azure resources through read-only Resource Graph queries with explicit subscription selection in a Copilot canvas.

plugins.name: azure-sre-agent
plugins.description: Investigate failing Azure apps with your existing Azure SRE Agent through an interactive Copilot canvas. Review investigation threads and incident evidence, and continue investigations with explicit user approval combined with your own context and tools.

plugins.name: azure-storage
plugins.description: Browse Azure Storage on a shared Copilot canvas: explore blobs, files, queues and tables, filter blob statistics, preview and download blobs, open read-only SAS links, and plan account-to-account copies.

plugins.name: backlog-swipe-triage
plugins.description: Quickly swipe through backlog issues to triage decisions like assign, needs-info, defer, close, or ignore.

plugins.name: backrooms-canvas
plugins.description: Wander an endless first-person backrooms in a Copilot canvas while agents work; their status ghost-writes on the walls.

plugins.name: bd-skills
plugins.description: Helps GitHub Copilot investigate mobile app telemetry, diagnose crashes, manage [bitdrift](bitdrift.ai) workflows and dashboards, integrate the Capture SDK into iOS, Android, and React Native apps, and configure User Journey monitoring. Includes four skills covering CLI operations, SDK instrumentation, documentation lookup, and user journey monitoring; live account operations require the bd CLI and [bitdrift](bitdrift.ai) account and authentication.

plugins.name: blea
plugins.description: Safe, agent-first Bluetooth Low Energy diagnostics with portable evidence capture/diff/replay and guarded writes through a Skill, CLI, and local MCP server.

plugins.name: bootui
plugins.description: Diagnose running Spring Boot and Quarkus applications with BootUI. Includes a setup and troubleshooting skill plus a local MCP connection for runtime diagnostics and evidence-based recommendations.

plugins.name: brainmaxxing
plugins.description: Codebase-grounded concept-mastery quizzes with an interactive BrainMax Canvas dashboard.

plugins.name: cache-stats
plugins.description: Shows live prompt-cache reuse, expiry, token composition, and AI Credit cost for the current GitHub Copilot session without making model calls.

plugins.name: canvas-authoring
plugins.description: Toolkit setup and Azure or counter starters for the host’s native `create-canvas` skill; skill-only, not a canvas extension.  Includes prebuilt packages and guidance for styles, sign in, subscriptions, telemetry, and more.

plugins.name: cast-imaging
plugins.description: A comprehensive collection of specialized agents for software analysis, impact assessment, structural quality advisories, and architectural review using CAST Imaging.

plugins.name: catalyst-by-zoho
plugins.description: Official GitHub Copilot plugin for Catalyst by Zoho — a full-stack serverless cloud platform. Includes skills covering services, SDKs, CLI workflows, architecture patterns, pricing, migration guides, and Zoho MCP resource management.

plugins.name: chat-cards
plugins.description: Interactive card deck in a GHCP canvas: tab cards, tables, SVG charts, show/hide sections, numbered outlines, rendered markdown documents, video clips, and forms whose submissions come back to the conversation as prompts.

plugins.name: chat-fork-map
plugins.description: Maps branching Copilot conversations so parallel follow-up questions and exploration paths from complex tasks or learning can be navigated without losing context. Its visual layout makes breadth-first exploration easier than managing multiple active threads in a traditional conversation list.

plugins.name: chrome-devtools-plugin
plugins.description: Reliable automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis in Chrome using Chrome DevTools and Puppeteer.

plugins.name: chromium-control-canvas
plugins.description: Opens a real Chromium window you can navigate and interact with from a Copilot canvas control panel and agent actions.

plugins.name: chronicle-stats
plugins.description: See your local Copilot token usage by day, model, and session, and get tips to use it more efficiently.

plugins.name: clojure-interactive-programming
plugins.description: Tools for REPL-first Clojure workflows featuring Clojure instructions, the interactive programming chat mode and supporting guidance.

plugins.name: cms-development
plugins.description: Skills for CMS development across themes, plugins, admin tooling, media workflows, markdown rendering, and static export pipelines.

plugins.name: cockroachdb
plugins.description: Connect GitHub Copilot to your CockroachDB clusters: run and explore SQL through MCP, with DBA/Developer/Operator agents, CockroachDB best-practice skills, and safety hooks that block destructive statements.

plugins.name: color-orb
plugins.description: A visual orb that users can ask the agent to recolor while showing a live activity log in the canvas.

plugins.name: connector-namespaces
plugins.description: Interactive GitHub Copilot canvas for discovering, connecting, and managing hosted MCP servers from an Azure Connector Namespace.

plugins.name: containers
plugins.description: Browse and operate local Docker containers and images in a Copilot canvas. Follow logs, watch resource usage, browse files, inspect image layers, and recover Dockerfile provenance.

plugins.name: context-engineering
plugins.description: Tools and techniques for maximizing GitHub Copilot effectiveness through better context management. Includes guidelines for structuring code, an agent for planning multi-file changes, and prompts for context-aware development.

plugins.name: context-matic
plugins.description: Coding agents hallucinate APIs. ContextMatic gives them curated, versioned API and SDK docs. Ask your agent to "integrate the payments API" and it guesses — falling back on outdated training data and generic patterns that don't match your actual SDK. ContextMatic solves this by giving the agent deterministic, version-aware, SDK-native context at the exact moment it's needed.

plugins.name: convert-to-md
plugins.description: A collection of Copilot skills that convert common document formats into Markdown so their contents can be accurately analyzed, summarized, searched, or extracted from. Just tell Copilot what you need — the right skill is invoked automatically and the conversion happens behind the scenes.

plugins.name: copilot-goal-skill
plugins.description: Goal-driven task orchestration with independent verification. Interviews the user to define a clear goal, then loops between a Builder subagent (does the work) and an Inspector subagent (judges the result with fresh context). The Inspector never trusts the Builder. Output is auditable in git commits from each subagent actions. Use when the user says "achieve this goal", "make this work", "implement until done", or wants verified autonomous task completion with independent quality review.

plugins.name: copilot-sdk
plugins.description: Build applications with the GitHub Copilot SDK across multiple programming languages. Includes comprehensive instructions for C#, Go, Node.js/TypeScript, and Python to help you create AI-powered applications.

plugins.name: copilot-session-dj
plugins.description: A playful, local Strudel soundtrack for the current GitHub Copilot session and its subagents. Includes an English/Japanese DJ Canvas, three synth-only presets, and silent-until-clicked playback with explicit stop controls.

plugins.name: crowdstrike-charlotte-ai-agentworks
plugins.description: CrowdStrike Charlotte AI AgentWorks skills for creating, managing, and invoking AI agents via external Falcon API Gateway endpoints. Includes agent lifecycle management, invocation, knowledge base operations, and discovery of models/tools/templates.

plugins.name: crowdstrike-falcon-foundry
plugins.description: AI coding assistant skills for building CrowdStrike Falcon Foundry apps: scaffolding, deployment, and best practices for API integrations, collections, functions, UI extensions, UI pages, and workflows.

plugins.name: crowdstrike-falcon-fusion
plugins.description: AI coding assistant skills for building CrowdStrike Falcon Fusion workflows: action discovery, YAML authoring, deployment, execution monitoring, and best practices for triggers, conditions, loops, and HTTP Actions.

plugins.name: csharp-dotnet-development
plugins.description: Essential prompts, instructions, and chat modes for C# and .NET development including testing, documentation, and best practices.

plugins.name: database-data-management
plugins.description: Database administration, SQL optimization, and data management tools for PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and general database development best practices.

plugins.name: datadog
plugins.description: Use Datadog directly in Copilot / VS Code through a preconfigured Datadog MCP server. Query logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and more through natural conversation.

plugins.name: dataverse
plugins.description: Microsoft Dataverse plugin for coding agents, covering record CRUD, bulk data operations, advanced queries, schema and metadata, administration, security, environment management, and solution lifecycle through MCP, CLI, and SDK workflows.

plugins.name: dataverse-sdk-for-python
plugins.description: Comprehensive collection for building production-ready Python integrations with Microsoft Dataverse. Includes official documentation, best practices, advanced features, file operations, and code generation prompts.

plugins.name: dependabot-triage
plugins.description: Triage Dependabot alerts and recommend safe, evidence-based dependency updates.

plugins.name: devops-oncall
plugins.description: A focused set of prompts, instructions, and a chat mode to help triage incidents and respond quickly with DevOps tools and Azure resources.

plugins.name: diagram-viewer
plugins.description: Render diagrams, click nodes to drill down, and view agent-generated explanations directly in the canvas.

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: C# language server (LSP) integration for coding agents and high-level .NET development skills.

plugins.name: dotnet-diag
plugins.description: Skills for .NET performance investigations, debugging, and incident analysis.

plugins.name: dotnet-test
plugins.description: Skills for running, generating, analyzing, and improving .NET tests: test execution, filtering, platform detection, coverage, testability, and MSTest workflows.

plugins.name: doublecheck
plugins.description: Three-layer verification pipeline for AI output. Extracts claims, finds sources, and flags hallucination risks so humans can verify before acting.

plugins.name: draw
plugins.description: Draw simple diagrams in a Copilot canvas: shapes, arrows that stay attached, text and a freehand pen. Copilot can read, create and edit the same drawing, tidy its layout, and export it as PNG or SVG.

plugins.name: edge-ai-tasks
plugins.description: Task Researcher and Task Planner for intermediate to expert users and large codebases - Brought to you by microsoft/edge-ai

plugins.name: edit-tutorial
plugins.description: Turn the code edits Copilot made in your session into an interactive lesson: a step-by-step walkthrough of each change with before/after views and quizzes, then a hands-on exercise that varies those edits so you finish the change yourself.

plugins.name: elasticsearch
plugins.description: Official Elastic plugin for GitHub Copilot — translate natural language to ES|QL queries, ingest data, manage Elasticsearch security (authn, authz, audit), and troubleshoot clusters. Powered by the official Elastic agent skills repository.

plugins.name: ember
plugins.description: An AI partner, not a tool. Ember carries fire from person to person — helping humans discover that AI partnership isn't something you learn, it's something you find.

plugins.name: excel-cli
plugins.description: Let your coding agent work with real Microsoft Excel workbooks from the terminal: formulas, Power Query, PivotTables, charts, and VBA. Same features as Excel MCP, usually with fewer AI tokens. Requires Windows, desktop Excel 2016 or later, and Node.js 18 or later.

plugins.name: excel-mcp
plugins.description: Let an AI assistant create and update Microsoft Excel workbooks: work with cells, formulas, Power Query, PivotTables, charts, and VBA in the desktop app. Requires Windows, desktop Excel 2016 or later, and Node.js 18 or later.

plugins.name: eyeball
plugins.description: Document analysis with inline source screenshots. When you ask Copilot to analyze a document, Eyeball generates a Word doc where every factual claim includes a highlighted screenshot from the source material so you can verify it with your own eyes.

plugins.name: fastah-ip-geo-tools
plugins.description: This plugin is for network operations engineers who wish to tune and publish IP geolocation feeds in RFC 8805 format. It consists of an AI Skill and an associated MCP server that geocodes geolocation place names to real cities for accuracy.

plugins.name: feedback-themes
plugins.description: Explore grouped customer feedback signals by impact and drill into a theme to guide product next steps.

plugins.name: figma
plugins.description: Plugin that includes the Figma MCP server and Skills for common workflows.

plugins.name: flight-map-canvas
plugins.description: A GitHub Copilot canvas that generates a view where Google Maps can be explored using 3D controls, as if a flight simulator. Agents can send the flight anywhere and report what they are working on.

plugins.name: flowstudio-power-automate
plugins.description: Give your AI agent full visibility into Power Automate cloud flows via the FlowStudio MCP server. Connect, debug, build, monitor health, and govern flows at scale — action-level inputs and outputs, not just status codes.

plugins.name: fluentui-blazor
plugins.description: Build Blazor apps with the Microsoft Fluent UI Blazor library. Bundles the fluentui-blazor skill for correct usage patterns (providers, service registration, icons, dialogs, data grid, theming) with the official Fluent UI Blazor MCP server for live lookup of components, parameters, enums, icons, and documentation, plus v4-to-v5 migration guidance.

plugins.name: foundation-models
plugins.description: Helps coding agents write and review Apple Foundation Models code for iOS, macOS, visionOS, and watchOS using the SDK installed on the developer's Mac. It verifies real API signatures and availability, then type-checks the result instead of relying on model memory.

plugins.name: foundry-agentic-loop
plugins.description: Build agentic solutions on Microsoft Foundry, GitHub and Azure. Prototype in an existing Foundry project, or run spec-driven development (SDD): a dynamic workflow that specifies, implements, verifies and deploys with azd behind evidence gates. Includes a canvas with a gallery of 61 industry prompt templates, a live workflow view and Foundry enablement, plus an improve mode that learns from past runs.

plugins.name: foundry-hosted-agent-copilotkit
plugins.description: Build CopilotKit + AG-UI web apps on Microsoft Foundry hosted agents (Microsoft Agent Framework): wiring, native Foundry primitives, human-in-the-loop approvals, azd deploy, and debugging — with the Microsoft Learn and Foundry MCP servers for live grounding.

plugins.name: frontend-web-dev
plugins.description: Essential prompts, instructions, and chat modes for modern frontend web development including React, Angular, Vue, TypeScript, and CSS frameworks.

plugins.name: gem-team
plugins.description: Self-Learning Multi-agent orchestration framework for spec-driven development and automated verification. With smarter tool calling and leaner context.

plugins.name: gesture-review
plugins.description: Review pull requests with a live camera feed and approve or reject using thumbs-up/thumbs-down gestures.

plugins.name: gh-skills-builder
plugins.description: Design, build, review, and publish GitHub Skills-style exercises with one coordinating agent and five Agent Skills for learner journeys, workflow-backed validation, and release readiness.

plugins.name: git-ape
plugins.description: Intelligent agent system for deploying any Azure workload through GitHub Copilot. Provides guided, safe, and validated deployments using ARM templates, with built-in security analysis, cost estimation, and CI/CD pipeline integration.

plugins.name: git-worktree-explorer
plugins.description: Visualize the active Git repository through worktrees, branches, commits, and optional GitHub pull request context.

plugins.name: github-copilot-modernization
plugins.description: Autonomous application modernization using multi-agent orchestration for GitHub Copilot CLI. Supports Java upgrades (8→21, Spring Boot 2.x→3.x), .NET modernization, Azure migration, CVE/vulnerability fixing, and application rearchitecture (monolith-to-microservices). Features a 3-level agent hierarchy (orchestrator → coordinators → executors) with enterprise rulebook support for embedding organizational policies into the workflow.

plugins.name: github-security
plugins.description: Review your session's changes for vulnerabilities and fix code scanning alerts

plugins.name: globestudio
plugins.description: Make dotted world maps and animated 3D globes and put them on a website. Bundles the globestudio skill, which writes the design as one config and embeds it as an iframe, a React component or a web component, with the hosted Globestudio MCP server for presets, share links and embed code. Free, MIT, no API key.

plugins.name: go-mcp-development
plugins.description: Complete toolkit for building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in Go using the official github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk. Includes instructions for best practices, a prompt for generating servers, and an expert chat mode for guidance.

plugins.name: incident-io
plugins.description: Official incident.io plugins for AI agents: skills for working with [incident.io](https://incident.io/) — incidents, on-call, and investigations — and for authoring the operational content our platform draws on.

plugins.name: java-development
plugins.description: Comprehensive collection of prompts and instructions for Java development including Spring Boot, Quarkus, testing, documentation, and best practices.

plugins.name: java-mcp-development
plugins.description: Build Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in Java with the official MCP Java SDK 2.x. Includes a skill that generates a server project and an expert agent for guidance.

plugins.name: java-modernization-studio
plugins.description: Drive the GitHub Copilot App Modernization for Java workflow from an interactive canvas: environment readiness, repo assessment, prioritized plan and progress, validation gates, and one-click predefined-task runs grounded in the repo's real artifacts.

plugins.name: jira-workbench
plugins.description: A Copilot app canvas that shows any Jira project's full hierarchy (epics, issues and subtasks) and traces each item to its Copilot sessions and GitHub pull requests. The canvas only reads Jira; it can start a scoped Copilot session from any issue.

plugins.name: jupyter-notebooks
plugins.description: Create, edit, run, save, and checkpoint Jupyter notebooks in an interactive Copilot canvas.

plugins.name: keep-the-why
plugins.description: Preserves or recovers the reasoning behind a codebase — architectural decisions, rejected alternatives, workarounds, incident learnings, operational constraints, and historical context the code itself cannot explain.

plugins.name: kotlin-mcp-development
plugins.description: Complete toolkit for building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in Kotlin using the official io.modelcontextprotocol:kotlin-sdk library. Includes instructions for best practices, a prompt for generating servers, and an expert chat mode for guidance.

plugins.name: markdstage
plugins.description: Create, edit, present, and export Markdown slides in a GitHub Copilot Canvas.

plugins.name: mcp-m365-copilot
plugins.description: Comprehensive collection for building declarative agents with Model Context Protocol integration for Microsoft 365 Copilot

plugins.name: megalinter
plugins.description: Set up, run and fix MegaLinter on any repository: 100+ linters for 69+ languages, 23+ formats and 21+ tooling formats, from CI or locally.

plugins.name: microsoft-docs
plugins.description: Access official Microsoft documentation, API references, and code samples for Azure, .NET, Windows, and more.

plugins.name: microsoft-events
plugins.description: Connect your project to Microsoft Build and Ignite sessions — discover relevant talks, explore what's new for your stack, and plan next steps from your development environment.

plugins.name: microsoft-foundry
plugins.description: Skills and interactive Copilot canvas for designing, configuring, testing and deploying agents to Microsoft Foundry.

plugins.name: mobile-canvas
plugins.description: View, create, boot, and interact with local iOS simulators and Android emulators from a GitHub Copilot canvas. The plugin also exposes the same device controls to agents through MCP.

plugins.name: modern-web-guidance
plugins.description:
Modern Web Guidance is an agent skill and CLI tool designed to help AI coding agents build web applications using modern, secure, and high-performance APIs rather than outdated workarounds.
Supported by the Google Chrome team, it injects expert-curated web platform best practices directly into an agent's context window to prevent the generation of bloated, legacy code.

plugins.name: modernization-workflow
plugins.description: Visualize and guide the GitHub Copilot Modernize CLI Assess, Plan, and Execute workflow for .NET, Java, and C++ application repositories.

plugins.name: modernize-dotnet
plugins.description: AI-powered .NET modernization and upgrade assistant. Helps upgrade .NET Framework and .NET applications to the latest versions of .NET.

plugins.name: modernize-java
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot modernization – Java Upgrade CLI Plugin helps you upgrade Java applications from the command line. It brings intelligent modernization capabilities to your terminal and CI/CD pipelines: analyze your project and generate an upgrade plan, automatically transform your codebase, fix build issues, validate against known CVEs, and output a detailed summary of file changes and updated dependencies.

plugins.name: msgraph-developer-skills
plugins.description: Builds and modernizes Microsoft Graph applications with minimal, purpose-built API clients. The plugin identifies the required Microsoft Graph endpoints and their least-privileged permissions, generates a focused client with [Kiota](https://aka.ms/kiota) or an AI-assisted workflow, and applies recommended authentication and SDK patterns.

plugins.name: napkin
plugins.description: Visual whiteboard collaboration for Copilot CLI. Opens an interactive whiteboard in your browser where you can draw, sketch, and add sticky notes — then share everything back with Copilot. Copilot sees your drawings and responds with analysis, suggestions, and ideas.

plugins.name: netlify
plugins.description: Netlify platform skills covering functions, edge functions, blobs, database, identity, image CDN, forms, config, CLI, frameworks, caching, AI Gateway, and deployment — plus the official Netlify MCP server for creating and managing projects, deploys, and environment variables.

plugins.name: nitrosend
plugins.description: Prepare and review email campaigns, automation flows, contacts and transactional messages in Nitrosend through its hosted OAuth MCP server. Includes a scoped skill for account selection, consent and live-send review.

plugins.name: noob-mode
plugins.description: Plain-English translation layer for non-technical Copilot CLI users. Translates every approval prompt, error message, and technical output into clear, jargon-free English with color-coded risk indicators.

plugins.name: openapi-to-application-csharp-dotnet
plugins.description: Generate production-ready .NET applications from OpenAPI specifications. Includes ASP.NET Core project scaffolding, controller generation, entity framework integration, and C# best practices.

plugins.name: openapi-to-application-go
plugins.description: Generate production-ready Go applications from OpenAPI specifications. Includes project scaffolding, handler generation, middleware setup, and Go best practices for REST APIs.

plugins.name: openapi-to-application-java-spring-boot
plugins.description: Generate production-ready Spring Boot applications from OpenAPI specifications. Includes project scaffolding, REST controller generation, service layer organization, and Spring Boot best practices.

plugins.name: openapi-to-application-nodejs-nestjs
plugins.description: Generate production-ready NestJS applications from OpenAPI specifications. Includes project scaffolding, controller and service generation, TypeScript best practices, and enterprise patterns.

plugins.name: openapi-to-application-python-fastapi
plugins.description: Generate production-ready FastAPI applications from OpenAPI specifications. Includes project scaffolding, route generation, dependency injection, and Python best practices for async APIs.

plugins.name: oracle-to-postgres-migration-expert
plugins.description: Expert agent for Oracle-to-PostgreSQL application migrations in .NET solutions. Performs code edits, runs commands, and invokes extension tools to migrate .NET/Oracle data access patterns to PostgreSQL.

plugins.name: orrery
plugins.description: Architecture and system design diagrams with official AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes and GitHub icons, auto-laid out by ELK and rendered from a YAML spec to SVG, PNG, editable draw.io, React TSX and a standalone HTML viewer.

plugins.name: ospo-sponsorship
plugins.description: Tools and resources for Open Source Program Offices (OSPOs) to identify, evaluate, and manage sponsorship of open source dependencies through GitHub Sponsors, Open Collective, and other funding platforms.

plugins.name: partners
plugins.description: Custom agents that have been created by GitHub partners

plugins.name: pcf-development
plugins.description: Complete toolkit for developing custom code components using Power Apps Component Framework for model-driven and canvas apps

plugins.name: phoenix
plugins.description: Phoenix AI observability skills for LLM application debugging, evaluation, and tracing. Includes CLI debugging tools, LLM evaluation workflows, and OpenInference tracing instrumentation.

plugins.name: php-mcp-development
plugins.description: Comprehensive resources for building Model Context Protocol servers using the official PHP SDK with attribute-based discovery, including best practices, project generation, and expert assistance

plugins.name: pm-skills
plugins.description: MCP server and 12 skills for product analysis, specification writing, strategy, narrative, and stakeholder alignment. Run competitive analyses, write zero-question specs, design metrics, and produce executive-ready documents directly from Copilot.

plugins.name: pmx-canvas
plugins.description: PMX Canvas is a collaborative canvas where you and your AI agent collect evidence, analyze findings, and develop ideas together. Pin material as context for your agent, then ask it to add findings, comparisons, or diagrams to the board for you to review, present, and build on.

plugins.name: postgres-skills
plugins.description: Expert PostgreSQL guidance and live database tools for Postgres anywhere, including local, self-hosted, containers, on-premises, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and Azure HorizonDB. Covers indexing, vector search and RAG, JSONB, partitioning, security, replication, and knowledge graphs with connection-aware guidance.

plugins.name: power-apps-code-apps
plugins.description: Complete toolkit for Power Apps Code Apps development including project scaffolding, development standards, and expert guidance for building code-first applications with Power Platform integration.

plugins.name: power-bi-development
plugins.description: Comprehensive Power BI development resources including data modeling, DAX optimization, performance tuning, visualization design, security best practices, and DevOps/ALM guidance for building enterprise-grade Power BI solutions.

plugins.name: power-platform-architect
plugins.description: Solution Architect for the Microsoft Power Platform, turning business requirements into functioning Power Platform solution architectures.

plugins.name: power-platform-mcp-connector-development
plugins.description: Complete toolkit for developing Power Platform custom connectors with Model Context Protocol integration for Microsoft Copilot Studio
